rules.title: uv cache
rules.explanation: uv's package cache. `uv cache prune` removes unused entries and is safe while uv is running.
rules.rebuildHint: uv re-downloads packages on next install

rules.title: npm cache
rules.explanation: npm's download cache. Rebuilt automatically on the next install.
rules.rebuildHint: npm re-downloads packages on next install

rules.title: npx package cache
rules.explanation: Packages fetched by npx / npm exec. Only cleared when no npx or npm exec process is running.
rules.rebuildHint: npx re-downloads tools on next run

rules.title: pnpm store
rules.explanation: pnpm's content-addressable store. `pnpm store prune` removes packages no project references.

rules.title: bun install cache
rules.explanation: bun's package cache.

rules.title: pip cache
rules.explanation: pip's wheel and HTTP cache.

rules.title: Homebrew downloads
rules.explanation: Old Homebrew downloads and outdated versions. `brew cleanup -s` also scrubs the download cache.

rules.title: Gradle caches
rules.explanation: Gradle dependency and build caches.

rules.title: Go build cache
rules.explanation: Go's compiled build cache. Rebuilt on next build.

rules.title: Cargo registry cache
rules.explanation: Downloaded crate archives and extracted sources.

rules.title: Puppeteer browsers
rules.explanation: Cache in ~/.cache/puppeteer. Safe to remove; re-downloads Chromium on next run.

rules.title: Playwright browsers
rules.explanation: Cache in ~/Library/Caches/ms-playwright. Safe to remove; re-downloads browsers on next `playwright install`.

rules.title: Hugging Face models
rules.explanation: Cache in ~/.cache/huggingface. Safe to remove; re-downloads models, often many GB.

rules.title: PyTorch hub cache
rules.explanation: Cache in ~/.cache/torch. Safe to remove; re-downloads model weights.

rules.title: Whisper models
rules.explanation: Cache in ~/.cache/whisper. Safe to remove; re-downloads speech models.

rules.title: Codex runtimes
rules.explanation: Cache in ~/.cache/codex-runtimes. Safe to remove; re-downloads on next Codex run.

rules.title: Chrome on-device AI model
rules.explanation: Chrome's optimization-guide model (~4 GB). Chrome re-downloads it when needed.

rules.title: Xcode DerivedData
rules.explanation: Xcode's build products and indexes. Rebuilt on next build.
rules.rebuildHint: next Xcode build is a full build

rules.title: Xcode Previews
rules.explanation: Old SwiftUI preview simulators and builds.

rules.title: App caches
rules.explanation: Per-app caches in ~/Library/Caches. Apps rebuild them. Apple-protected caches can't be removed and are skipped, not reported as failures.

rules.title: Docker build cache
rules.explanation: BuildKit cache from `docker build`. Pruned per builder by name. Never touches containers or volumes.
rules.rebuildHint: next image build re-runs uncached steps

rules.title: Dangling Docker images
rules.explanation: Untagged image layers no tag points to.

rules.title: Shrink Docker disk image
rules.explanation: Docker's VM disk keeps space after deletes. fstrim inside the VM hands it back to macOS.

rules.title: Unused Docker images
rules.explanation: Tagged images no container uses. Re-pulled or rebuilt when needed.

rules.title: Old VS Code extension versions
rules.explanation: VS Code keeps old extension versions after updates. Only the newest of each is kept.

rules.title: Old Cursor extension versions
rules.explanation: Cursor keeps old extension versions after updates. Only the newest of each is kept.

rules.title: Idle project build folders
rules.explanation: Build output and dependencies in projects you haven't touched recently. Rebuilt by the project's install/build command.

rules.title: Finished git worktrees
rules.explanation: Clean worktrees with no unpushed commits. `git worktree remove` keeps the branch.

rules.title: Simulator runtimes
rules.explanation: Xcode simulator runtimes. Re-downloadable from Xcode > Settings > Components.

rules.title: Virtual machines
rules.explanation: Parallels, UTM and VMware virtual machines. Your data lives inside; moved to the Trash, not deleted.

rules.title: TeX Live
rules.explanation: A full TeX distribution. Reinstall from MacTeX if you need LaTeX again.

rules.title: Anaconda / Miniconda
rules.explanation: A conda Python distribution with its environments.

rules.title: Local AI models
rules.explanation: Models downloaded by Ollama or LM Studio. Duplicates are flagged.

rules.title: Large files
rules.explanation: Files over 1 GB in Downloads and Documents.

rules.title: Old installers
rules.explanation: Disk images, packages and archives in Downloads older than 30 days.

rules.title: Old Xcode device support
rules.explanation: Debug symbols for old iOS/watchOS versions. Xcode re-copies them when you connect a device on that version.

rules.title: Possible personal data in projects
rules.explanation: Large data extracts (CSV, Excel, Parquet, JSON) inside project folders may hold personal data. Consider moving them to approved storage. Never uploaded, never sent to the AI.

rules.title: Leftovers of trashed apps
rules.explanation: Support files left behind by apps in your Trash.

rules.title: Protected by macOS
rules.explanation: Shown so the numbers add up. macOS protects these or deleting them frees nothing.
